body:
## Pull request overview

This PR standardizes adapter routing by moving most API namespaces behind a single catch-all that forwards requests to `HttpDispatcher.dispatch()`, preventing missing-route 404s (notably in Vercel/serverless deployments) and reducing duplicated route registration logic across adapters.

**Changes:**
- Replaces per-namespace routing (meta/data/etc) with a unified catch-all delegating to `HttpDispatcher.dispatch()` across adapters, keeping only framework-specific routes explicit (auth/storage/graphql/discovery).
- Updates the Hono adapter test suite to validate catch-all dispatch forwarding (method/path/body/query).
- Adds adapter changelog entries describing the new routing approach.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 15 out of 15 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

| packages/adapters/hono/src/hono.test.ts | Rewrites tests to validate catch-all `dispatch()` behavior and query/body forwarding. |
| packages/adapters/hono/CHANGELOG.md | Documents the catch-all dispatch change and the Vercel 404 fix. |

`metadata()` calls `dispatcher.dispatch()` with `body || req.body` for all HTTP methods. While `handleMetadata()` currently ignores `body` for non-PUT methods, other dispatch targets might not; for consistency with the other adapters in this PR, consider only passing a payload for POST/PUT/PATCH and using `undefined` otherwise.

NestJS adapter now delegates meta/data via `dispatcher.dispatch()` and adds a `@All('*')` catch-all, but `packages/adapters/nestjs/src/nestjs.test.ts` still asserts `handleMetadata()`/`handleData()` calls. Update the NestJS tests (mock + assertions) to validate `dispatch()` and the new catch-all behavior so package tests stay passing.

CHANGELOG entries were added for version `3.2.8`, but `packages/adapters/hono/package.json` still declares version `3.2.7`. If this repo uses Changesets (it has a `.changeset/` setup), consider adding a changeset and letting `changeset version` generate consistent package.json + changelog updates, or bump the package versions in the same PR.

Adapter now routes meta/data/etc through `dispatcher.dispatch()`, but the existing Fastify unit tests still assert calls to `handleMetadata()` / `handleData()`. Update `packages/adapters/fastify/src/fastify.test.ts` (mock + assertions) to validate `dispatch(method, subPath, body, query, ctx)` instead, otherwise `pnpm test` (turbo) will fail.

Nuxt adapter now delegates most routes via `dispatcher.dispatch()`, but `packages/adapters/nuxt/src/nuxt.test.ts` still expects `handleMetadata()`/`handleData()` calls. Update the mock dispatcher and assertions to cover the new catch-all dispatch behavior so package tests remain green.

SvelteKit adapter now delegates non-auth/graphql/storage routes via `dispatcher.dispatch()`, but `packages/adapters/sveltekit/src/sveltekit.test.ts` still asserts `handleMetadata()`/`handleData()` calls. Update the mock + expectations to validate `dispatch()` (method/path/body/query forwarding), otherwise the adapter test suite will fail.

Next.js adapter now uses the catch-all `dispatcher.dispatch()` path for meta/data/etc, but `packages/adapters/nextjs/src/nextjs.test.ts` (and related tests) still assert `handleMetadata()`/`handleData()` calls. Update the mocks/assertions to validate `dispatch(method, path, body, query, ctx)` to avoid failing `turbo run test`.
